about.checkFailedHint: Check your connection and try again. Orla also tries again later on its own.
about.lead: A calmer desktop. Your files stay where they are; Orla only changes how you see them.
about.license: Open source under the MIT license. Nothing leaves your computer.
about.neverChecked: Orla looks for new versions on GitHub every few hours.
about.notInstalled: This copy does not update itself
about.notInstalledHint: It was built from the source. The installer and ZIP versions update themselves.
about.quitHint: Closes the panels and brings back the Windows icons as they were.
about.tourHint: Five quick tips, right on your panels.
about.updateHint: The update installs on its own when you close Orla, or now if you prefer.
appearance.animationsHint: Short transitions when panels appear. They follow the Windows animation setting.
appearance.opacityHint: How much wallpaper shows through. The minimum keeps text readable over any image.
appearance.themeHint: With System, Orla follows the Windows app theme.
central.desktopUnorganized: Desktop, only what is not in another panel
central.folderPick: Choose the folder this panel shows. The files stay in it.
central.panelsEmpty: No panels yet. Create a collection to gather shortcuts, or a folder panel to see a folder right on the desktop.
central.panelsLead: Collections hold shortcuts to files from anywhere. Folder panels show what is inside a folder and update on their own.
central.panelsTip: Drag files from File Explorer onto a panel. With {0}, panels come in front of your windows so you can drop files without minimizing anything.
error.guard: Orla could not start the safeguard that brings the icons back. The Windows icons stay visible.
error.layoutUnreadable: Orla could not read your panels. A copy of the file was kept at {0}. None of your files were changed.
error.missing: This item is no longer where it was saved. Use the item's menu to take it out of the panel.
error.title: Orla Desktop
error.tooManyPanels: You already have {0} panels. Remove one to create another.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong, so the Windows icons were restored to be safe. Details: {0}
general.arrangeHint: Brings the visible panels to the main screen and lines them up in columns, with the middle free.
general.cleanHint: Hides the Windows icons and leaves only the panels. While it is on, selecting with the mouse on the desktop is unavailable. The icons come back when you turn this off or quit Orla.
general.hotkeyHint: With the desktop in view, {0} hides or shows the panels. With a window on top, it brings the panels to the front; press it again, or Esc, to send them back.
general.languageHint: Changes right away. With System, Orla follows the Windows display language.
general.lockHint: Prevents moving or resizing a panel by accident.
general.resetConfirmMessage: Panels leave the desktop and settings return to their defaults. A copy of the current layout is kept in Orla’s data folder. None of your files are moved or deleted.
general.resetHint: Removes every panel, returns settings to their defaults and opens the welcome screen, as after a fresh install. Your files are not affected.
general.shortcutHint: Click the button and press the new combination.
general.shortcutInvalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win together with another key.
general.startupHint: Your panels appear as soon as you sign in.
general.updatesHint: Every few hours, Orla checks GitHub for a new version and installs it when you close the app or the next time it starts. None of your data is sent.
notice.hidden: The {0} panel is hidden. Show it again from Panels in Orla.
notice.hotkeyTaken: Another program already uses {0}. Your panels are still available from the Orla icon in the notification area.
notice.recovered: Your panels were recovered from the last saved copy.
notice.updateReady: Orla {0} has been downloaded and installs when you close the app.
notice.updated: Orla was updated to version {0}. Click to see what is new.
organize.cardHint: Orla reads your desktop and builds panels by category: programs on the left, work on the right and the middle left free. You see a preview before anything changes.
organize.cleanHint: Only while Orla is open. Anything without a category goes to the “New on desktop” panel.
organize.completeLead: {0} new items: {1} in panels you already have and {2} in new panels.
organize.completeNone: Nothing new on the desktop: your panels already show everything.
organize.completeNote: Nothing moves: names, colours, positions and what you moved stay as they are.
organize.failed: The desktop could not be read right now. Try again in a moment.
organize.keepHint: Each new item on the desktop goes to its category's panel by itself.
organize.lead: {0} items in {1} panels. Nothing moves on disk: panels show shortcuts to your files.
organize.nothing: Your desktop is empty for now. With Keep organized on, whatever lands there goes to the right panel.
organize.replaceNote: Your current panels will be replaced. A copy is kept, and you can undo it in Panels.
organize.secondHint: Tools go to the other monitor, and work stays on the main screen.
organize.title: Your desktop, organized
panel.addFolderHint: Choose the folder. It stays where it is.
panel.empty: Drag files, folders or shortcuts here. Nothing is moved.
panel.folderEmpty: This folder is empty. Drag files here to move them into it.
panel.folderMissing: This panel's folder was not found. Check that the drive is connected.
panel.inboxEmpty: All tidy. Whatever lands on the desktop shows up here.
panel.onlyUnorganized: Show only what is not in another panel
panel.removeFolderMessage: The panel leaves the desktop. The folder and its files stay where they are.
panel.removeMessage: The panel and its shortcuts leave the desktop. Your files stay where they are.
panel.removeSensorsMessage: The panel leaves the desktop. You can bring it back from the Performance page.
perf.cpuTemperatureHint: Windows does not report the processor temperature without an extra driver, and Orla does not install drivers.
perf.diskHint: The chart shows the busiest disk.
perf.lead: How your computer is doing right now, updated twice a second.
perf.networkHint: Strong line: receiving. Faint line: sending.
perf.notReported: The display driver does not report this value.
perf.powerHint: How much of the card’s maximum power it is using, as the driver reports it.
preset.appsHint: The program shortcuts on your desktop.
preset.desktopHint: What lands on the desktop and is not in any panel yet. Pairs well with hidden Windows icons.
preset.documentsHint: Your Documents folder, always up to date.
preset.downloadsHint: Your Downloads folder, always up to date.
preset.gamesHint: Games and launchers found on the desktop and in the Start menu: Steam, Epic, Riot, EA, Ubisoft and more.
preset.performanceHint: Live CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network.
preset.quickAccessHint: This PC, Downloads, Documents, Pictures and Recycle Bin.
preset.recentHint: The files you opened last, newest first.
preset.screenshotsHint: Each screenshot shows up here as soon as it is saved.
preset.studyHint: An empty collection for classes, reading and notes.
preset.workHint: An empty collection for everyday files.
search.keys: Enter opens, Ctrl+Enter shows in folder, Esc clears
status.fallback: Compatibility mode: the Windows desktop was not found.
tile.missing:
{0}
This item is no longer here.
tile.renameHint: Changes only the name shown in the panel. The file keeps its name.
tour.barText: It looks through everything your panels show. Click it or start typing on a panel; Esc clears it and, the second time, lets go of the focus.
tour.menuText: In ··· or with a right-click: rename, colours, automatic height and more. Right-click an item to open it, rename it or take it out of the panel.
tour.moveText: Drag a panel by its title wherever you like. It sticks to the screen edges and to other panels, and never sits on top of another.
tour.resizeText: Pull any edge or corner. The panel fits whole columns and rows of icons. Double-click the bottom edge to return to automatic height.
tour.searchText: With the desktop in view, it hides or shows the panels. With a window in front, it brings the panels and the search bar above it, ready for typing.
tour.searchTitle: {0} does what the moment calls for
tour.trayText: Click the Orla icon in the notification area to open settings, organize again or search. That is all: the desktop is yours.
welcome.alongsideHint: Your desktop stays the same: icons, mouse selection and the right-click menu. In the next step, you choose the panels that go next to them.
welcome.lead: Choose how to start. You can change everything later.
welcome.organizeHint: Orla builds panels by category from what is on your desktop: programs on the left, work on the right. You see a preview first, and no file moves.
welcome.presetsLead: Tick what you want to see on your desktop. You can add or remove panels later with New panel.
welcome.presetsLoading: Looking at what is already on this computer…
welcome.tip: Tip: {0} brings the panels to the front at any time.
welcome.title: Welcome to Orla Desktop
